sourceText:
Kickoff Mary
By: Lauren
Published: Sunday, January 29, 2012 - 3:50pm

Ingredients




20 oz tomatoes, finely chopped
1.5 cups tomato juice
cup vodka
1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
1 tablespoon Tobasco sauce
1 tablespoon horseradish
1/2 lime juiced
3 stems of fresh cilantro finely chopped
ice to serve
celery
salt & pepper

Preparation

1 - Place tomatoes and 1 tablespoon salt in a bowl and allow to sit in the fridge for at least an hour. 2 - Place the tomato pieces in a blender with the tomato juice, Worcestershire, Tabasco horseradish and lime and blend until smooth. 3 - When ready to serve divide mixture into quarters, pour into a shaker with 1/4 cup vodka, chopped cilantro & lots of ice. Shake and serve chilled. 4 - Garnish with salt & pepper, lime and celery!

About

A great way to start off Superbowl Sunday regardless who's playing!!
